```{r profile-pubs}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Publications pulled from publications.bib for this person (matched on the `family` front-matter field),
# newest first. With `pubs: primary`, only lab-led papers are listed, capped at `pubs_max` (default 8).
m <- rmarkdown::metadata
fam <- tolower(m$family %||% "")
giv <- tolower(m$given %||% strsplit(trimws(m$title), " ")[[1]][1])   # given name: `given` field, else the first word of the title
if (nzchar(fam)) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(RefManageR))
  bib <- ReadBib("../../publications.bib", check = FALSE)
  strip <- function(x) if (is.null(x) || !length(x)) "" else gsub("[{}]", "", as.character(x[[1]]))
  # an author matches when the family name is equal and the first given name is a prefix of ours or vice versa (Jeff ~ Jeffrey)
  is_me <- function(a) {
    f <- tolower(paste(a$family, collapse = " ")); g <- tolower(gsub(".", "", (a$given %||% "")[1], fixed = TRUE))
    f == fam && (!nzchar(g) || startsWith(giv, g) || startsWith(g, giv))
  }
  yr <- function(e) { y <- strip(e$year); if (y == "in press") 9999 else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y)) }
  keep <- vapply(seq_along(bib), function(i) any(vapply(bib[[i]]$author, is_me, logical(1))), logical(1))
  if (identical(m$pubs, "primary")) keep <- keep & vapply(seq_along(bib), function(i) identical(tolower(strip(bib[[i]]$primary)), "true"), logical(1))
  first <- function(i) isTRUE(is_me(bib[[i]]$author[[1]]))   # with pubs_first: true, first-authored papers come before the rest
  idx <- which(keep); idx <- idx[order(if (isTRUE(m$pubs_first)) -vapply(idx, first, logical(1)) else 0, -vapply(idx, function(i) yr(bib[[i]]), numeric(1)))]
  cap <- m$pubs_max %||% if (identical(m$pubs, "primary")) 8 else 100
  idx <- head(idx, cap)
  if (length(idx)) {
    esc <- htmltools::htmlEscape
    items <- vapply(idx, function(i) {
      e <- bib[[i]]
      title <- strip(e$title); venue <- strip(e$journal %||% e$booktitle %||% e$publisher); year <- strip(e$year)
      doi <- strip(e$doi); pre <- gsub("\\\\_", "_", strip(e$preprint)); url <- strip(e$url)
      link <- if (nzchar(doi)) paste0("https://doi.org/", doi) else if (nzchar(pre)) pre else url
      au <- vapply(e$author, function(a) paste(a$family, collapse = " "), character(1))
      au <- if (length(au) > 6) paste0(paste(au[1:5], collapse = ", "), ", … & ", au[length(au)]) else if (length(au) > 1) paste0(paste(au[-length(au)], collapse = ", "), " & ", au[length(au)]) else au
      star <- if (identical(tolower(strip(e$primary)), "true")) '<span class="star" title="Led by our lab">★</span>' else ""
      t <- if (nzchar(link)) sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>', esc(link), esc(title)) else esc(title)
      sprintf('<li>%s%s<span class="meta">%s · %s · %s</span></li>', star, t, esc(au), esc(venue), esc(year))
    }, character(1))
    heading <- if (identical(m$pubs, "primary")) "Selected Publications" else "Publications with the Lab"
    cat(sprintf('\n\n## %s\n\n<ul class="mini-pubs">%s</ul>\n<p class="mini-pubs-more"><a href="../../publications.html">See all lab publications</a></p>\n', heading, paste(items, collapse = "")))
  }
}
```
